description: The single allowlist of manager-core/test/no-family-branches.test.js (00 §9.11, 01 §26 ENG-23). Each entry allows exactly count hits of one pattern in one file, until it expires.

entries.reason: Engine-id dispatch, not a model family: the precheck applies each manager's artifact rules (GGUF for llama.cpp; config, safetensors and trust_remote_code for vLLM) keyed by the legacy engine id. Descriptor artifactFormats can replace it.
